description: Build a third-party ransomware risk report for up to 100 vendors (domains or company names). For each vendor: matching leak-site claims (group, claimed and first-observed dates, sources), a risk level (high = claim in the last 90 days, elevated = last 12 months, historical, none_found, unknown) and follow-up actions; plus a portfolio summary with priority vendors and the groups involved. Use it for vendor reviews and audits; use batch_exposure_check for a cheaper raw check of up to 25 domains. Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach; none_found is not proof of absence. Fails (not charged) if the source is down for more than 25% of vendors. Read-only; one flat price. Costs $3 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

vendors.description: Vendor domains or company names, 1-100, e.g. ["acme.com", "Example Corp"]

name: vendor_risk_report
